newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - i2 Technologies cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - i2 Technologies cut.

text.p: Hambrecht & Quist said it cut its rating on shares of i2 Technologies Inc to hold from buy following that company's announcement of two acquisitions, Think Systems Corp and Optimax Systems Corp.
-- said the acquisitions heightened the near-term execution risks for i2 Technologies.
-- maintained 1997 earnings estimate of $0.40/shr and 1998 estimate of $0.65/shr.
-- The stock was off 2-1/4 to 37-1/2 at midday.
